overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies dehydrated fenugreek seeds sourced and processed in India. We clean, sort, and dry mature Trigonella foenum-graecum seeds under controlled conditions to maintain natural aroma and physical purity. The whole seeds feature a characteristic warm, bitter, and earthy profile. They contain no intentionally added preservatives or artificial colors, serving industrial processors across international spice markets.

As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we offer whole seeds, cracked seeds, and custom mesh powders. Our operations support OEM private labeling and bulk supply with an MOQ starting at 5 Kg. We maintain moisture levels at or below 8 percent and follow a disciplined six-step preparation process to ensure consistent quality for global food formulations.
highlights: Whole dehydrated fenugreek seeds of Indian origin
Moisture content controlled to 8 percent or less
Cleaned and sorted with 99 percent minimum purity target
Distinctive warm, earthy, and aromatic profile
Available as whole seeds, cracked, or custom mesh powder
Twelve-month shelf life under recommended storage conditions
applications: Curry powder and traditional spice blend manufacturing
Ready-to-cook meal formulations and instant mixes
packaging: 25 kg bags and durable HDPE containers
Small private-label pouches and PET jars

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for fenugreek seeds?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity starts at 5 Kg for standard supply, with flexible volumes available for commercial bulk programs.

faqs.q: Can you supply fenugreek in powder form as well as whole seeds?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer whole seeds, cracked seeds, and custom milled powder, including standard 60 to 80 mesh sizes upon request.

faqs.q: What is the typical shelf life and storage recommendation?
faqs.a: The product has a shelf life of 12 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you provide OEM and private label packaging services?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide complete OEM and private labeling, including small retail pouches, jars, and customized outer cartons.

faqs.q: What export documentation and registration credentials do you hold?
faqs.a: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, offering export documentation support for international shipments.

faqs.q: Are product samples available before confirming a commercial order?
faqs.a: Yes. Product samples are available on request to evaluate aroma, purity, and particle size prior to bulk purchasing.
